Emma (Support): FYI customer 'AcmePayments' just opened an escalation — their embeddings usage chart in Console shows ~3.2M units for the last 24h but their billing export shows ~1.1M tokens. They suspect vectors being counted as tokens or double-counting across pipelines.
Liam (SRE): Oof. Do we have a repro or a query they ran? Any screenshots?
Emma (Support): Attached screenshot and their console query: `granularity=1h&metric=embeddings_usage&group_by=model,route` — they say the chart y-axis label is `units` but tooltip shows both "vectors" and "tokens" numbers.
Devin (Product): Can you paste the screenshot here? Also which org / project ID? We need to know if this is the new analytics pipeline or legacy.
Emma (Support): Screenshot pasted, org id: org-8743. They mention this started after the last console release (2 days ago).
Anika (ML): From quick look, the metrics pipeline tags embeddings calls as `embedding_vector_count` and we also emit `token_count` from downstream text pipelines. If the dashboard query isn't filtering by metric_type, aggregation could be summing both.
Kai (Eng): I remember we changed the dashboard to auto-aggregate metrics by `unit` to support mixed payloads. Might be a bug where `unit` enum values ("vectors","tokens") got canonicalized to the same key when `model_variant` is null. That would cause double-counting.
Liam (SRE): Can someone run an ad-hoc query on metrics-store for org-8743 for last 48h? I want to see raw rollups.
Anika (ML): Running now. Query (pseudo):
```
SELECT timestamp, metric_type, unit, sum(value) FROM metrics.rollup
WHERE org_id='org-8743' AND metric_name='embeddings_usage' AND ts >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY timestamp, metric_type, unit
```
Results show two series at same timestamps: one with unit='vectors' and one with unit='tokens' but both are being returned under the same chart series id in the dashboard layer.
Devin (Product): That explains the doubled numbers — the UI groups by `metric_name` only and not by `unit`. The tooltip added both counts for visibility, but the y-axis stacks them.
Emma (Support): Customer says the spike aligns with a batch job that wrote 2.1M vectors. Billing only charged for tokens (1.1M). They want a correction on the chart (not billing).
Kai (Eng): Short-term workaround: filter dashboard to `unit=vectors` in the query or use the new filter pill for metric tags. I'll add a quick docs note.
Devin (Product): Medium-term fix: change default grouping to include `unit` and ensure series ids include unit so the front-end doesn't coalesce. Also add a validation to prevent stacking unit-distinct metrics.
Liam (SRE): Is there any chance this affected billing? We don't want discrepancies causing downstream charge disputes.
Anika (ML): Billing pipeline is separate and uses raw ingestion events, so billing numbers are authoritative. This is purely an analytics/visualization bug.
Emma (Support): Customer still worried. Requested an internal note and ETA. They want the chart corrected and a one-off exported CSV of vectors vs tokens for their account.
Kai (Eng): I can produce CSV from raw rollups and share. Will also push a hotfix to dashboard grouping logic — should be a small change to the frontend series key and a tweak in the backend query builder.
Devin (Product): Prioritize as P2 since it's customer visible and causing trust issues with metrics. Assign owners: Kai for hotfix, Anika for query validation, Emma to coordinate with customer and deliver CSV, Liam to monitor for similar orgs.
MetricsBot: Incident note created: INC-2026-324 — analytics dashboard mis-aggregates embeddings units (vectors vs tokens). Linked channels: #support, #product, #eng.
Emma (Support): I'll tell AcmePayments the workaround and that we have an incident and an ETA for the hotfix today. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Kai (Eng): Hotfix branch created: `fix/analytics-unit-grouping`. I’ll open a PR after unit tests. ETA ~3 hours for PR, 8 hours for deploy to staging.
Anika (ML): Also adding an automated test that rejects queries that would coalesce different `unit` values into a single series.
Devin (Product): After hotfix, we should sweep top 50 orgs with embeddings volume to ensure they didn't see the same UI artifact. Liam — can we run a quick scan?
Liam (SRE): On it. I'll run a query for orgs with embeddings_usage > 500k in last 7 days and list dashboards referencing `embeddings_usage`.
Emma (Support): Customer follow-up: they appreciate the quick response. Asked we mark any overcounted chart points as "visual-only" until fixed.
Kai (Eng): Will add a temporary banner on affected charts that flags "unit-mix present — values may represent combined units (vectors + tokens)".
Devin (Product): Good call. Also update the changelog and send a short note to customers who opted into analytics beta.
Emma (Support): I'll prepare the customer CSV and send once Kai pushes the export.
MetricsBot: Update: INC-2026-324 status changed to "investigating" -> "in progress" at 1763285000.
Liam (SRE): Scan results: 12 orgs affected, including 3 customers with >1M vectors/day. I'll DM owners.
Devin (Product): Thanks. Post-mortem action items: default group-by include `unit`, UI banner for mixed units, export helper for vectors vs tokens, and monitoring alert when `unit` distribution for a metric is >1.
Emma (Support): Closing loop with AcmePayments now. I'll paste planned timeline and the CSV when available.
Kai (Eng): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/4821 — hotfix + banner + tests.
Emma (Support): Customer replied: "Appreciate the fast turnaround." :relieved:
Devin (Product): Nice work everyone. We'll track INC-2026-324 through completion and then run the sweep and notify customers.
Emma (Support): Thanks all.
